title: Oriented C¹ graph chart of an embedded (n+1)-submanifold over its tangent plane, with the Jacobian orientation formula (parent step 4)
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, P := n + 1 + k, N ⊆ ℝ^P an embedded C² submanifold of dimension n + 1 (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n+1) N), ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) an orientation of N (IsOrientation (n+1) N ξ_N) and x ∈ N. Then there are linear isometries ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^P, a map u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^k and δ₁, δ₂ ∈ ℝ such that: (a) ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, and every y ∈ ℝ^P equals ιv + ι'w for some v, w; (b) δ₁ > 0, δ₂ > 0, u is C¹ on the ball B_{δ₁} := ball(0, δ₁) ⊆ ℝ^{n+1}, u(0) = 0, Du(0) = 0 (fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0) and u(B_{δ₁}) ⊆ ball(0, δ₂) ⊆ ℝ^k; (c) with Γ(v) := x + ιv + ι'u(v): N ∩ {x + ιv + ι'w : |v| < δ₁, |w| < δ₂} = Γ(B_{δ₁}); (d) ξ_N(x)(α) = α(ιe_0, …, ιe_n) for every (n+1)-covector α (e_j the standard basis vectors EuclideanSpace.single j 1); (e) for every v ∈ B_{δ₁} and every (n+1)-covector α, α(DΓ(v)e_0, …, DΓ(v)e_n) = √det(DΓ(v)*∘DΓ(v))·ξ_N(Γ(v))(α), where DΓ(v) = fderiv ℝ Γ v and DΓ(v)* is its adjoint.
